verdict.rationale: Temporal's Client documentation says it can send Signals to running Workflow Executions, and Temporal says it can orchestrate workflows across any length of time. Together these imply a workflow can be fed human input while it runs, but the evidence never describes pausing a workflow until an approval arrives. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a workflow blocking or waiting on a Signal for human approval, an ops-facing approve/resume flow (UI or CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pause a workflow to wait for human approval or input before it continues

citations.quote: enabling you to start Workflow Executions, send Signals and Queries, and retrieve results
Orchestrate your workflows, AI apps, and agents across any models, tools, systems, and length of time.
